current_WRD_context.interpretation: Targets/tokens are not independent full trajectories. Component SFT is a testable hypothesis; complete-model sufficiency is not established.

papers.title: LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment
papers.unit: curated prompt-response examples in main experiment

precise_primary_evidence.short_excerpt: using at least 2,000 examples improved stability in this setting.

papers.critical_boundary: 7B ablation footnote reports improved stability with at least 2000 examples. General response alignment and text preference are not autonomous tool-pipeline success.

papers.title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs
papers.unit: filtered agent interaction trajectories, six task families

precise_general_data_evidence.short_excerpt: yielding 57,096 conversations with GPT-3.5 and 3,670 with GPT-4.

papers.critical_boundary: Mixed general data matters; not all trajectory records are full multi-step episodes. Mind2Web filtering permits reward >=2/3. Held-out tasks influenced mixture selection, unlike a strictly sealed final test.
papers.rationale_provenance_note: Some task-derived trajectories lacked thoughts and received later GPT-4 supplementation; such supplementation is not recovered original reasoning.

papers.title: FireAct: Toward Language Agent Fine-tuning
papers.unit: successful GPT-4 HotpotQA agent trajectories in default single-task setting
papers.critical_boundary: Search-QA tool and answer EM, not reusable-skill production. 77% is relative improvement, not absolute success. Model-dependent data curves disallow a universal 500-example rule.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.unit: curated training samples, not tokens/API calls/unique task episodes
papers.student_method: SFT only; no student RL in reported distillation
papers.critical_boundary: Broad reasoning transfer, not WRD environment control. Multiple correct responses may share a prompt. Teacher preparation is substantial and is not a free-cost assumption.

research_recommendations_not_executed.data_sufficiency_decision: Use clean independent task outcomes and source-level learning curves; no cross-paper numeric threshold.
evaluation_isolation: Freeze new independent dev/test by source, material ancestry and connected component.
Keep original226/H12/static out of training and tuning.
Do not count action windows, retries or task variants as independent test tasks.
A small flow-smoke set is technical acceptance only; this recommendation does not assert any newly completed clean evaluation task count.
capability_tests: Component correctness: parameters, resource completeness, factual fidelity, diagnosis and local repair.
Autonomy: one native model controls the entire loop from new conversation/materials without outer step dispatch.
Skill utility: same-version skill consumption versus no-skill with separate delivery success, independent Q and cost.

learning_curve.execution_scope: Design suggestion only; do not automatically run all configurations.
learning_curve.first_comparison: Untuned baseline plus two data endpoints, then add levels/seeds only within a separately declared budget.
learning_curve.model_comparison: 14B main and 8B control share data splits, tools, context and evidence rules.
learning_curve.confounding_control: Distinguish one-pass data expansion from fixed-compute repetition; neither alone proves a universal sufficient sample count.

acceptance: Predeclare outcome quality, autonomous completion and total-cost requirements.
Use task/source-level uncertainty and paired comparisons.
A plateau below required performance is failure to meet the goal, not evidence that data are sufficient.
Reasoning style similarity and loss reduction are not causal-policy validation.
Zero qualified skills makes cost per qualified skill undefined.
